HasUponPickupEffect.rationale: Matches JewelryBox.cs:17; same is_tradable consequence recorded for relic/golden_pearl in this batch.

AfterObtained.maps_to: after_obtained (jewelry_box.py:15-18) -> run.add_card(make_card('apotheosis')) (run.py:524-537, renumbered since prior pass, content unchanged)
AfterObtained.rationale: JewelryBox.cs:19-23 creates an Apotheosis on the run and adds it to PileType.Deck. run.add_card runs modify_card_being_added_to_deck before the append and after_card_added_to_deck after it -- the two deck-add hooks the sim models -- and appends at the END of the deck, which is the position CardCmd.cs:437 pins for out-of-combat additions. EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b07.py box-apotheosis): deck 10 -> 11 with 'apotheosis' as the last entry. The card is ported (cards/apotheosis.py, an Ancient 2-cost Skill). Rule 7: run.py and cards/apotheosis.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N1: `CardCmd.PreviewCardPileAdd(..., 2f)` (JewelryBox.cs:22) and the Apotheosis hover tip (line 15)
guards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / FlashSfx / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / InvokeDisplayAmountChanged / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.PreviewCardPileAdd are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter, sfx and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.

guards.what: N2: `RunState.CreateCard<Apotheosis>(Owner)` vs `make_card('apotheosis')` -- the C# card is created ON THE RUN and owned by the player; the sim's make_card has no owner
guards.rationale: Ownership is a multiplayer concept (`card.Owner == base.Owner` guards exist all over the source for exactly that reason) and collapses in a single-player sim, where every card in run.deck belongs to the one player. Checked deliberately because CreateCard also assigns the card its combat scope; run.add_card's card enters combat through CombatState.__init__'s pile build (combat.py:121-..., class CombatState, renumbered since prior pass, content unchanged), which is the sim's equivalent binding. Rule 7: combat.py is not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N3: the sim's Relic.undo_after_obtained is not implemented, so a Jewelry Box the conformance runner grants and then un-picks leaves an Apotheosis in the deck
guards.rationale: Same reasoning and same verdict as relic/golden_pearl guard N3 in this batch (binding rule 3): undo_after_obtained has no C# counterpart, so its absence is not a divergence from the source. Flagged for the same reason -- the runner compares the deck as (id, upgrade_level) pairs, so the stray Apotheosis reads as a deck divergence until the next resync. Rule 7: relics/base.py and conformance/runner.py are not hashed by this record.
